main_text.head: MITHRIDATES ad Lectoren.
main_text.p: Hæc hactenus de diversis linguis, quantum hoc tempore præstare potui, tum me-opte studio & observatione, tum ex aliorum scriptis & lectionibus (præcipue vero ex Guil. Postelli, viri in omni doctrinarum & linguarum genere præstantissimi, de duodecim linguis libro, & altero de characteribus Phœnicum, nonnulla sum mutuatus:) tum bonorum virorum collatione. Inter quos Theodorus Bibliander, theologus in-signis, & varia rerum linguarumque scientia clarus, præceptor meus observandus, quod ad linguas Hebraicæ affines, institutum meum promovit. Spero autem homines studiosos audaciam meam benigne interpretaturos. De omnibus enim linguis scribere sum ausus, non sane quod argumen-to me satisfacturum sperarem, qui ne de ver-nacula quidem hoc polliceri ausim, sed ut excitarem alios, qui de singulis pluribusve sive ipsi lucubrationibus propriis, quod mallem: sive ad me nostra aliquan-do augendi aut emendandi gratia perscriberent.

page.notes: Long s rendered as f in the scan was normalised to plain s: "sum" (printed "fum"), "ausus" ("aufus"), "sperarem" ("fperarem"), "singulis" ("fingulis"), "sed" ("fed"), "satisfacturum" ("fatisfacturum"), "Spero" ("fpero"). Doubtful: "meo-opte" hyphen at line end read as "me-opte"; the word "sum" after "nonnulla" is uncertain due to smudging and marked here as read. No page number, running head or catchword is printed.
